featured_reviews.name: Pravin Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited McDonald's CSMT near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, and it was a convenient stop in the middle of a busy day in South Mumbai. The outlet is located in a prime area, making it an easy choice for travelers, office workers, and students looking for a quick and reliable meal. Due to its central location, the place is usually crowded, but the system runs smoothly.

The service here is completely self-service. You place your order at the counter or digital kiosk, wait for your token number, and collect your tray once it’s ready. Even during rush hours, the process is quite organized, and the staff handles the crowd efficiently. The waiting time was reasonable, and the order was served fresh.

We ordered a chicken burger combo, cheesy fries, Oreo shake, and a Mc coffee cappuccino. The chicken burger combo was satisfying, with a soft bun and a crispy chicken patty that had the familiar McDonald’s taste. The fries served with the combo were fresh and crispy. The cheesy fries were a highlight, topped with warm, creamy cheese sauce that added extra flavor and made them more indulgent.

The Oreo shake was thick, chilled, and perfectly sweet, making it a refreshing treat. It had a good blend of Oreo flavor and creamy texture. The Mc coffee cappuccino was nicely prepared, with a smooth texture and balanced coffee taste, perfect to relax after a long day.

The taste overall follows their standard franchise model, which means you get consistent flavors just like any other McDonald’s outlet. The seating area is decent, though it can feel a bit crowded during peak hours. Cleanliness is maintained well, and tables are cleared regularly.

Overall, it was a satisfying experience for a quick meal near CSMT. My rating for this outlet is 4 out of 5.

customer_updates.name: SMRUTISIKHA PRADHAN
customer_updates.text:
• Cannon Pav Bhaji is one of Mumbai's most famous street food destinations, located opposite CSMT.
• Established in 1975 by a former Indian Army veteran, it has been serving Mumbaikars and travelers for decades.
• Known for its rich, buttery, and flavorful pav bhaji made in the traditional Mumbai style.
• The pav is perfectly toasted with butter and pairs wonderfully with the delicious bhaji.
• The place has a unique old-Mumbai charm and is an important part of the city's food heritage.
• Despite being a simple standing food stall, it attracts food lovers from across India.
• Quick service, authentic taste, and a nostalgic atmosphere make the experience memorable.
• A must-visit spot for anyone who wants to enjoy Mumbai's legendary pav bhaji and experience a piece of the city's culinary history.

Overall: Great taste, rich history, and a true Mumbai street-food experience. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text: Canon Pav Bhaji did not live up to the hype at all. I have had much better pav bhaji at many other places. I ordered one Amul Butter Pav Bhaji and one Amul Butter Cheese Pav Bhaji. Both were extremely bland and lacked proper spices. There was an excessive amount of butter added, to the point that only butter’s taste was overpowering everything else—no real flavor of the bhaji could be felt. The pav bhaji was not even served properly hot, which made the experience worse. On top of that, the prices are very high for the quality and taste offered. This review is purely based on my personal experience, and unfortunately, it was very disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Cannon Pav Bhaji near CST and, unfortunately, the experience was quite disappointing. We tried several items Pav Bhaji, Sheera, Sabudana Khichdi and Lassi and to be frank, everything was absolutely tasteless. For a place that is always crowded and located in such a prime spot, I genuinely expected much better in terms of flavour and quality.

The Pav Bhaji lacked the rich, buttery taste and balanced spices that you normally find even at simple street side stalls across Mumbai. The Sheera was bland and lacked the aroma and sweetness that make it enjoyable. Sabudana Khichdi, which is usually comforting and flavourful, felt underwhelming as well. Even the Lassi didn’t have the freshness or thickness you would hope for.

It feels like the only advantage this place has is its central location right outside CST, which naturally attracts tourists and daily commuters. In contrast, some of the other nearby stalls actually serve tastier food at far more economical prices.

Overall, Cannon Pav Bhaji didn’t live up to its hype or its location. If you’re looking for flavourful, satisfying Mumbai street food, you’re better off exploring the smaller stalls around the area.

featured_reviews.name: Vainateya Sahasrabudhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre in Mumbai my grandfather used to take me to have pav bhaji 2000 to 2014. Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre is a renowned destination for street food enthusiasts, serving mouth-watering pav bhaji that has captured the hearts of many. This iconic eatery has earned a reputation for its delicious food, prompt service, and cozy ambiance.

Ambiance
The ambiance at Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre is warm and inviting, perfect for a quick bite or a casual meal with friends and family. The decor is minimal, but the vibrant atmosphere and aroma of freshly cooked food make up for it.

Menu and Offerings
Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre's menu is centered around its signature dish, pav bhaji, which is a flavorful mix of vegetables cooked in a rich tomato-based gravy, served with soft, buttery pav bread. Some popular items on the menu include-
- *Pav Bhaji*: The star of the show, made with a medley of vegetables and spices, served with pav bread.
- *Special Pav Bhaji*: A variation of the classic dish, made with extra butter and spices.

Quality and Taste
The quality and taste of Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre's offerings are exceptional. The pav bhaji is cooked to perfection, with a rich, buttery flavor that's hard to resist. Customers rave about the delicious food, and many have returned for years, making it a testament to the eatery's consistency.

Service
The service at Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre is prompt and efficient, ensuring that customers receive their orders quickly and without any hassle. The staff is friendly and courteous, adding to the overall positive experience.

Value for Money
Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre offers excellent value for money, with prices starting from around ₹120-₹200 per person for a meal. Given the quality and quantity of food, it's a steal.

Tips
- Visit Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre during off-peak hours to avoid crowds.
- Try the special pav bhaji for an extra-rich flavor experience.
- Pair your pav bhaji with a buttermilk, lassi or cold drink for a refreshing contrast.

Online Ordering and Delivery
For those who prefer the convenience of home delivery, Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre offers online ordering through platforms like Justdial and Zomato. This allows customers to enjoy their favorite dishes from the comfort of their own homes.

Overall Experience
Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to experience the best of Mumbai's street food scene. With its delicious pav bhaji, prompt service, and excellent value for money, it's a culinary gem that will leave you wanting more.

Rating: 4.5/5 stars.

featured_reviews.name: Seon Almeida
featured_reviews.review_text:
"Burger King CSMT: Room for Improvement 🍔

A week ago, I visited the Burger King outlet opposite CSMT station. Although the outlet was spacious, my experience was marred by a few issues. The air conditioning seemed to be malfunctioning or was inadequate near the counter, prompting me to head upstairs to dine.

Unfortunately, the upstairs area had a strong, unpleasant odor, which was off-putting. Moreover, my order wasn't served hot – while the fries were warm, the burger was lukewarm. This inconsistency in food temperature was disappointing.

Given Burger King's reputation for quality food, I hope the management addresses these issues. Ensuring that food is served hot and maintaining a clean, odor-free environment are crucial for customer satisfaction.

Rating: 2.5/5 stars ⭐️

I hope Burger King takes constructive feedback seriously and works on improving their service and dining experience."

featured_reviews.name: Ayaskant parija - AK
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in the bustling Fort area of Mumbai, the Burger King outlet stands as a reliable spot for a quick and affordable fast-food meal. Situated near the VT (Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus) station, its prime location makes it a popular choice for commuters, students, and tourists exploring the city's historic core. The restaurant generally maintains a good reputation, with a user rating of approximately 4.0 out of 5 across various platforms, though feedback is often mixed, highlighting both strong suits and areas for improvement.
Ambiance and Service
The Burger King in Fort is noted for its spacious and well-lit interiors. Customers frequently describe the ambiance as casual and suitable for a quick bite with friends and family. The establishment is generally considered clean and hygienic, with clean washrooms being a point of praise.
However, the service experience appears to be a mixed bag. While many reviews commend the staff for being courteous and polite, suggesting the "best combos" to customers, others point to significant issues. Recurring complaints mention unorganized, slow service and, in some cases, rude behavior from the staff. This inconsistency suggests that the quality of service can vary depending on the time of day and staff on duty. Similarly, some customers have reported issues with air conditioning not working properly, which can be a concern during Mumbai's humid climate.
Food Quality and Menu Offerings
As a Burger King outlet, the restaurant serves its signature flame-grilled burgers, with the Whopper being a consistent favorite. Both the vegetarian and non-vegetarian Whoppers are highly regarded for their flavor and are a must-try for first-time visitors. Other popular items include the Crispy Chicken Burger and the Veg Makhani Burst Burger. Sides like Cheesy Fries and Peri-Peri Fries are also well-received, though some customers feel the quantity of fries is a bit small for the price.
The menu is designed to cater to a diverse clientele, offering a mix of classic international items and local Indian-inspired flavors. The food is generally considered fresh and tasty, living up to the brand's standard. The approximate cost for a meal for two is around ₹450, which is seen as an affordable and good value proposition for the location.
Overall Verdict and Recommendations
Overall, the Burger King in Fort is a convenient and generally pleasant place to grab a meal. Its location is a major plus, and the food quality is consistent with the brand's reputation. While the ambiance is good, the service can be a point of friction, so it's best to be prepared for potentially slow service, especially during peak hours.
If you're in the Fort area and craving a classic flame-grilled burger, this outlet is a solid choice. For a smoother experience, consider visiting during non-peak hours.

featured_reviews.name: Faiz F
featured_reviews.review_text:
Once a legendary staple of Mumbai’s culinary scene since 1958, Gulshan-e-Iran appears to have lost the magic that built its heritage. The shift away from their famous buff seekh has left a noticeable void in the menu that the chicken alternatives simply cannot fill. A recent attempt at the Chicken Seekh Kabab and Tawa Paratha proved to be a major disappointment, lacking the flavor profile one expects from such an established name. While the Chicken Kheema in Green Masala offers a saving grace with its well-balanced, mild spices, the overall lack of variety in the tawa and grill sections forced a pivot to basic Dal Rice just to round out the meal.

Ultimately, this iconic spot now functions better as an emergency food option rather than a dining destination. Given its location in a high-traffic business market with limited surrounding choices, it serves its purpose for a quick, functional bite, but it no longer carries the "must-visit" status of its glory days. For those seeking a more satisfying meal in the area, Patel Restaurant stands out as the superior recommendation.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to  lodge a serious complaint regarding unsafe and contaminated food sold at Neelam Food Centre located inside Mumbai Railway Station.

On 16 February 2026 at approximately 12:07 PM, I purchased food items including a chicken puff, paneer puff, and samosa from this outlet. After taking two bites of the chicken puff, I noticed a strong foul smell and was shocked to find visible fungal contamination in the food. I immediately reported this to the outlet management; however, they initially denied responsibility and provided unreasonable explanations despite the fungus and smell being clearly evident.

After considerable argument, the staff replaced the chicken puff with a paneer puff, but unfortunately the replacement item was also spoiled, with a very bad smell and visible fungus. Later, after boarding the train, my family attempted to eat the samosa we had purchased, and it was also found to be spoiled. Since three different food items were unfit for consumption, we were forced to discard all the food, resulting in a complete waste of money and a serious risk to passenger health.

Following this incident, I suffered severe stomach pain, vomiting, and loose motion during the journey, causing significant physical distress.

This level of negligence is extremely alarming. Selling fungus-contaminated and spoiled food at a major public transport hub endangers the health and safety of passengers. I strongly request the concerned authorities to:

• Conduct an immediate hygiene and safety inspection of the outlet
• Review CCTV footage dated 16 February 2026 at 12:07 PM for verification
• Take strict legal action against the responsible vendor
• Cancel or suspend the food licence if violations are confirmed
• Ensure that proper food safety and hygiene standards are strictly enforced

I am attaching copies of the purchase bill and photographs of the contaminated food as supporting evidence.

I request urgent action in this matter to prevent similar incidents and to protect public health.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Yours faithfully,
S.md. sharuk hussain

featured_reviews.name: Shambhavi Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy to see this famous UK chain here in India. Lovely, warm, welcoming restaurant and helpful staff. Food was mouth-watering, became a fan of their dough balls and the dips that come with it. Neapolitan pizzas we're incredible.
The Chicken Frichos were average, a bit dry, but the mint dip they provided was delicious.
The cocktails and mocktails were the main attraction for us. The Spiced Mango cooler was a banger which I'll highly recommend to everyone.
The place has a cozy vibe and the tasty foods speaks for itself for the good quality ingredients they use to cook it. We also tried the chocolate cheesecake which had a perfect texture, sweetness and freshness to it.
The only con was that we had visited on the weekend and our 2nd doughball order took almost 25-30 mins to come, which the staff came and mentioned later that the raw material ran out and they had to make it from scratch again for everyone. Which was a mood killer in the end as we waited too long after our dinner for simply 8 pieces of doughballs. I hope they sort this out soon, as everything else was perfect.

featured_reviews.name: Chirag Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dining here is delightful!

We never felt bloated even after the complete meal. Tummy never gets upset. This place deserves the premium it commands.

We tried the Loaded Frichos, Doppio Dough balls for starters.

Pasta cravings were satisfied by Ravioli Veg and Lasagna Veg. Ravioli was delicious and I loved the sauce. Lasagna had thin sheets and the char grill marks didn't work for me.

Calabrese Veg Pizza and Tandoori chicken pizza. Olives are BIG! I couldn't taste the cheese tbh but I am not complaining as everything just feels so fresh. The dough is always fresh but the chicken felt plain with no marination so I would be biased towards veg.

For mocktails we tried the bloody Mary and Berry slushy, both were good.

For dessert the chocolate fudge cake was yum!

The restaurant has been renovated recently and it has scored full marks on ambience and the staff is helpful.

Totally worth every penny! Don’t miss this one. A big shoutout to Shyam for the warm service and helpful recommendations. 👏

featured_reviews.name: Farhan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hitchki s one of the most popular restaurants in Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), known for its Bollywood-inspired interiors and innovative Indian menu. The moment you walk in, the lively ambience, desi décor, and upbeat music set the tone for a great dining experience. It’s a perfect spot for casual dinners, celebrations, and influencer-friendly content.

We tried a mix of starters, mains, and desserts, and every dish delivered on flavour. The Nacho Nacho Regular was crunchy and addictive, while the Mangalorean Roast Chicken brought authentic coastal flavours to the table. The Godfather Chicken was rich and indulgent, and the Malvani Kolambi Masala stood out with its bold spices and perfectly cooked prawns—easily one of the best seafood dishes in BKC.

Dessert lovers should not miss the Lotus Biscoff Tiramisu, which was smooth, creamy, and beautifully balanced. Paired with their signature drinks like BBC, Hitchki (BKC) proves why it’s among the best restaurants and bars in BKC. Highly recommended for great food, lively vibes, and a memorable dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Avish Navsaria
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hitchki is a great place to enjoy great vibes with energetic music, Dj and delicious food. They have a great ambience with plenty of safe and amazing seating arrangement. They have great menu with innovative names for all their dishes making it even more exciting to order. The service is very fast and good. The drinks are worth trying and of great innovation. The dishes I tried here were:

1) BIHARI KEBAB: It had Specialty Of Chef Dipesh + Age Old Recipe + Dry Masala Rub +
Tandoori Chicken + Tamatar Chutney. Must try.

2) CAESAR CHICKEN TIKKA: It had Parmesan Malai Marinade + Tandoor Cooked Chicken +
Garlic Parmesan Aioli.

3) ASIAN KITCHEN (CHICKEN): We customised it with Hakka Noodles + Manchurian Garvy + Chicken added. Really tasty and amazing.

4) DESI GIRL COCKTAIL: It has Tequila, Orange Marmalade, Desi Magoi Masala Punch, Red Wine Float + Chakna on top, perfect for a drink.

5) DEEWAR COCKTAIL: It has Whisky + Spiced Jaggery + Bitters + Apple Wood Smoke, amazing presentation and worth trying.

6) GODFATHER CHICKEN: It had Italian Herb Grilled Chicken + Potato Wedges + Sautéed Veg +
Mushroom Pepper Brown Sauce. Perfect for a person who wants to stay on proper diet.

7) Jungle Jungle Pata Chala Hai: A delicious dessert which has Black Forest Pastry 2.0 + Dark Chocolate Mousse + Cherry Mousse +
White Chocolate Ganache + Cherry Gel + Milk Chocolate Shavings.

It’s an all together complete place to visit with great music, food, drinks and service.

featured_reviews.name: Rimita D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Hitchki at BKC, around 7-10 minutes from Kurla station by auto/4 wheeler. It's a vibrant Bollywood themed restaurant and a perfect evening party spot. The presentation of every dish was top-notch.
We tried Masala Soda, Main Toh Superman, Tiger Jhinga Hai, Prawns Jaaye Par, Pressure Cooker Chicken Tikka Biryani, Godfather Chicken, and Lotus Biscoff Tiramisu all impressive, especially the above appetizers which are highly recommended. Chicken lovers must try the Godfather Chicken for its great portion size and taste.
Lotus Biscoff Tiramisu wasn’t overly sweet and made a perfect ending. Loved the playlist too, you will surely vibe on it. Special thanks to Salman and the entire team for the excellent service.

featured_reviews.name: Prakash Dhalwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hitchki BKC is a great spot for a fun lunch or evening out! The vibe is absolutely lovely — beautiful interiors with a cool bar-like feel that makes the whole experience enjoyable.

We tried quite a spread — nachos with cheese, garlic cheese bread, truffle fries, butter chicken seekh kebab, and paneer chilly, and everything was delicious! The truffle fries and seekh kebab were personal favourites. The only miss for us were the butter garlic prawns, which didn't quite live up to the rest of the menu.

Service was prompt and attentive, and we didn't have to wait long for a table at lunch — always a bonus! Valet parking is available which is super convenient for BKC.

Overall a solid dining experience and would definitely recommend it for the vibe and food. Will be back to explore more of the menu! 🙌

featured_reviews.name: Jinal Tank
featured_reviews.review_text: We tried a variety of dishes at Hitchki and had a great experience. The spring rolls and fried dumplings were crispy and tasty. Paneer makhani was rich and creamy with soft naan, while the noodles with Manchurian gravy were flavorful and filling. The dessert with ice cream was a perfect sweet ending, and the mocktails were refreshing. Overall, good food, nice presentation, and worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Raunak Bhutani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have been visiting hitchki bkc for over 6 years but the recent visit left no desire for us to be back again.
Ordered their new Dhurandar chicken which was quite average, the rotis served with it were a disaster, they felt raw hardly even roasted in the tandoor. When we conveyed the same to the person who served us (who also turns out to be the manager) was straight up arrogant and replied that he could only microwave it. Yes sure only forgetting that this isn't some random canteen where he is doing us a favour of serving food.
The basics of service is to first listen here it's the opposite when he gives us such great suggestions.
Such arrogance when the restaurant was almost empty on a weekend lunch would leave the restaurant much emptier in the future as it should be.
Having recommended hitchki to so many would have to do the opposite this time.
The second order Nasi goreng was extremely stale, the satay alongside was not hot, the preparation extremely salty.
Nothing worked apart from the parle G dessert which at least provided some sweetness to our rather sour experience.

featured_reviews.name: Arjika S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bayroute BKC never disappoints — but this time, they’ve truly outdone themselves with their Kebab & Meze Festival. The moment you step in, the ambience wraps you in warm golden lights and Mediterranean charm — it’s luxe yet cozy, elegant yet soulful.

I started my meal with the Ruyhan, a bright orange cooler that’s refreshing and slightly citrusy — the perfect start to a rich Middle Eastern feast. Their Zaffrani Chai was another star — aromatic, creamy, and comforting, with just the right hint of saffron.

Coming to the food — the Moroccan Chermoula Prawns were perfectly grilled and bursting with smoky, tangy flavours, while the Djej Al Jibneh was every cheese lover’s dream come true — tender chicken layered with molten cheese that melts in your mouth.

For mains, I tried the Kebab Koobideh, and it was absolute perfection — juicy, buttery kebabs served with saffron rice that complemented every bite. The textures, the balance of spice, and that authentic Persian touch made it unforgettable.

And of course, no visit to Bayroute is complete without dessert — the Chocolate Kunafa was the ultimate showstopper! Crisp golden strands on top, gooey chocolate inside, and just the right level of sweetness — the perfect ending to a luxurious meal.

Overall, Bayroute continues to deliver an experience that goes beyond just food — it’s a full-on sensory journey through the Middle East. Every dish feels thoughtfully crafted, the staff is super courteous, and the attention to detail is immaculate.

✨ Must Try:
•	Moroccan Chermoula Prawns 🦐
•	Djej Al Jibneh 🧀
•	Kebab Koobideh 🥩
•	Chocolate Kunafa 🍫
•	Zaffrani Chai ☕

Whether you’re a Middle Eastern food lover or someone just exploring new flavours — this festival is not to be missed!

featured_reviews.name: Archit Chitre
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience. Visited Bayroute for an authentic Lebanese lunch and wasn’t disappointed. The staff is warm and the ambience is welcoming. We chose the Kebab platter and a Hummus starter paired with cocktails and wine. Everything was delicious. Quantity and price are both reasonable and you can also get additional discounts via Dineout on pre-bookings. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Mithil Thakker
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bayroute is a legendary brand which serves middle eastern and Mediterranean Cuisine .

Their BKC outlet is definitely one of the most marvelous one with amazing interiors and supreme hospitality. Mr Jayesh served us with great care and is a superb bartender

My food recommendations.

Bayroute Hummus with Pita and Pickled Salad .
This one is a house Speciality and definitely not to be missed when out here .The  combination worked well when enjoyed along with warm pita bread.

Falafel Shawarma:
Definitely the hero dish of the afternoon. Fresh pita stuffed with succulent falafel bullets. Love it to the core.

Pide :
Pide means Turkish Flat Canoe (boat)  Shaped Pizza . We tried their         Peynir version which was really tasty and had a beautiful mix of cottage cheese & burata.

The Baklava milk shake is a  luscious drink to go with above meal.

Lastly we tried their House speciality Baklava which is served in the most beautiful way ever.

In Cocktail Sumac De-Light is a definite must try . This one too comes with a top-notch presentation.

Will definitely visit one of our favourite brand soon.
Happy & Safe Fooding until next time.....

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Gokani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bayroute in BKC is one of those places that instantly sets the mood the moment you walk in. The ambience is warm, elegant, and inviting, with beautiful Middle Eastern accents that make it perfect for a relaxed meal or a special outing. It feels upscale yet comfortable, and the overall vibe adds so much to the dining experience.

We started with the Hummus Bayroute, which was incredibly smooth, rich, and full of flavor — easily one of the best hummus options on the table, paired perfectly with fresh bread. The cottage cheese shawarma was a pleasant surprise, well-spiced, hearty, and packed with textures that made every bite satisfying. The koshari was comforting and wholesome, with a great balance of lentils, rice, and sauce, making it both filling and flavorful.

For desserts, the baklava was crisp, nutty, and just the right amount of sweet, ending the meal on a high note. The Arabic date palm shake was indulgent, naturally sweet, and refreshing, while the Thai Meets Middle East drink was a fun, creative fusion — refreshing, unique, and definitely worth trying.

Overall, Bayroute BKC delivers on ambience, quality, and flavors, making it a great spot for Middle Eastern food lovers and anyone looking for a refined yet cozy dining experience. Definitely a place you’d want to revisit.

featured_reviews.name: shubham sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Bayroute recently and honestly, it was such a lovely experience. The place has this calm, aesthetic vibe with warm lighting and cozy seating that instantly makes you feel comfortable. The ambience is beautiful and unique; every corner looks picture-perfect. The presentation of each dish was stunning. Every plate looked thoughtfully crafted with attention to detail.
The food was rich in flavor and beautifully balanced. The Greek Goddess and Muhammara had fresh, authentic Mediterranean flavors, while the Lavash Crust Chicken Kabsa was perfectly cooked and full of aroma. My favorite was definitely the Salted Caramel Baklava Shaikh thick, creamy, nutty, and just the right amount of sweet. It felt like the perfect dessert to end the meal.
The Moroccan Charmoula and Dijaj Tria had a lovely mix of spices, giving that true Middle Eastern taste. Everything tasted fresh and flavorful without being too heavy.

Also, a big thumbs-up to their hospitality. The staff was warm, polite, and very attentive, making the whole experience even better. Overall, Bayroute is that perfect blend of great food, beautiful ambience, and amazing service. Totally worth a visit!

featured_reviews.name: Veeni Saumil Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a lovely experience at Bayroute, BKC.
Bkc Restaurants have some special charm.  The place has a very warm and beautiful ambience with soft lighting and Arabic-inspired decor. The hot-air-balloon style ceiling and overall setup really add to the charm and make it feel special.
We started with our drinks which were refreshing and set the tone for a good evening.
Coming to the food, we enjoyed everything we tried.
The Pide Pizza was soft, flavourful and really comforting.
The Fatar Baklava with mushroom filling was one of the best dishes of the night, rich and literally melt-in-the-mouth.
The Cottage Cheese Shawarma was my personal favourite, something I would happily go back for.
We also tried the Koshari, their popular Arabic rice dish, which tasted wholesome and nicely balanced.
We ended the meal with their Baklava dessert, which came with a fun presentation and tasted amazing.
Overall, Bayroute BKC is a great place if you love Middle Eastern food or just want a nice dining experience with good ambience, flavourful food and a relaxed, premium feel.

featured_reviews.name: J G Irani
featured_reviews.review_text:
All routes are leading to BAYROUTE at BKC, Mumbai. No doubt, it's the most popular restaurant for specialties which include Middle Eastern, Arabic and Mediterranean dishes. The cuisine delivers delicacies like melt in your mouth kebabs, authentic hummus, signature baklava, pides, pizzas etc in veg and non veg preparations. Must try their Sumac De Light,

featured_reviews.name: Deep Sett
featured_reviews.review_text:
TOTALLY AVOID WASTING RS 5000.

At the onset this is probably one of the most expensive Buffets you would be having in Mumbai, priced at over 4300 plus taxes for a Dinner on a Weekday for an adult. Add to that, even as a gold accor member you probably get 20-30 percent instead of the normal 50 percent for 2 people is taxing.

The spread is decent, the variety in principal is there, but in terms of the taste and the quality of food, it’s really one of the poorest of the five stars , even considering the Leela and Lalit brands in Mumbai whose lay is very modest compared to this.

At almost 5000 you expect
1. Your veg sushi not being dumped in the refrigerator for you to pick up, questioning when it was made !

2. No juice , cold drink or mocktails are part of this offering. An advise to the team, you’re charging 5000 offering a drink probably at times could feel better than half the items on the menu.

3. I have seen just one Langarwaali daal the last 4 times I have gone here, to be honest , a Dal Makhani is the norm, if not that a top of the line dal Tadka.

4. Some dishes are borderline tasteless and on the menu just to increase the offerings on paper / website
A. Sushi - cold, refrigerated, and tasted as if it was made with zero interest.
B. Pizza Margerita- looked like an Udipi version not one served at a top 5 star, see the pictures yourself.
C. Fattoush salad, I mean if anyone has had a look at what they serve with that name, it’s embarrassing.
D. Starters like paneer tikka seem like lying there unattended for hours.
E. Many of the deserts too seem just good looking and tasting on borderline just sugar toffees.

When you come to a place , the stature of a Sofitel From the ACCOR elite stable, you expect basic standards and taste but unfortunately that’s missing.

The fact that it’s in BKC and most people have very little options for a 5 Star experience, plus because of its location the occupancy is high, is the best answer to why it’s half full during these buffets otherwise as per the taste of the food it should be  probably amongst the slowest moving places ever.

Sofitel I have over 11 million people reading this, so I’m saying this with humility please pull up and improve , make prices more competitive and the food seem like it’s made with care for the guests and hopefully the most charm would be back.

Till then all the best!!

I recently visited Burger King, and while the food was on par with what you'd expect from any other Burger King outlet, I couldn't help but notice a few areas where the restaurant fell short. Overall, it was a satisfactory experience, but there are improvements that could be made to enhance the cleanliness and atmosphere of the store.

Let's start with the positive aspects. Burger King consistently delivers when it comes to their burgers. The patties were juicy, the buns were fresh, and the toppings were flavorful. If you're a fan of their classic menu items, you won't be disappointed. The service was also prompt and efficient, ensuring that I didn't have to wait too long for my order.

However, the cleanliness of the restaurant left much to be desired. As I entered, I immediately noticed a water leak on the left side of the store, resulting in a wet and potentially hazardous area. This issue needs immediate attention from the management. Maintaining a clean and hygienic environment is crucial for any dining establishment, and it's disappointing to see such a visible problem that needs fixing. Moreover, the overall atmosphere of the store could use improvement.

Despite these shortcomings, I must emphasize that the burgers themselves were satisfying. The taste and quality were consistent with what you'd expect from Burger King, and if you're a fan of their offerings, you won't be disappointed in that regard.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited KFC Kurla and had a positive experience overall. The place has a lot of potential if they continue to maintain their service and cleaning standards.

The food at KFC Kurla was up to the usual KFC standards. The fried chicken was delicious, crispy, and flavorful, just as one would expect from KFC. The menu had a good variety of options, including burgers, chicken wings, and sides like coleslaw and mashed potatoes. The portions were generous, and the food was served hot and fresh.

The staff at KFC Kurla were attentive and friendly. They took our orders promptly and made sure we had everything we needed. The service was efficient, and our food arrived quickly. The staff also kept the dining area clean and tidy throughout our visit.

I didn't have any complaints about my experience at KFC Kurla. The food was satisfying, the service was good, and the overall atmosphere was pleasant. If KFC Kurla continues to maintain its service and cleaning standards, I believe it has the potential to be a great place for KFC lovers.

I would recommend giving KFC Kurla East a try if you're in the area and craving some delicious fried chicken.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Its simply just convenient. Nothing memorable

Cos of the veg array

I keep coming back to this vegetarian restaurant, and if I’m being honest, geography is doing a lot of the heavy lifting here. It’s conveniently close enough that my laziness can overpower my cravings for a while.

The food is fresh, well-made, and clearly prepared with care. The menu does a commendable job of convincing vegetables to impersonate things they were never meant to be. Some dishes even come dangerously close to making me forget about real food- meat.

Unfortunately, I was raised on a steady diet of creatures that once had opinions, so my deeply ingrained bias toward real food remains the ultimate buzzkill. Every bite is accompanied by a tiny voice in my head asking, “This is nice, but we paying
Fr veggie food bro?”

That said, if you’re vegetarian, you’ll probably love it. If you’re a carnivore like me, you’ll still enjoy it—especially if it’s close enough that convenience can temporarily defeat instinct.

Would return. Mostly because it’s nearby. Partly. Thats it

featured_reviews.name: Avdesh Rana
featured_reviews.review_text:
Burger King is my go-to when I’m craving a quick, filling burger that doesn’t cost a bomb. Their Whopper is still the best thing on the menu—big, juicy, and loaded with toppings. The fries are crisp and fresh most of the time, and the peri-peri seasoning is worth adding.

The only issue is consistency—sometimes the burgers are perfect, other times the lettuce is soggy or the patty feels overcooked. Service speed depends on the branch; at busy locations, you might wait longer than expected for “fast food.”

Prices are reasonable, especially if you grab one of their combo offers or app deals. Seating is usually clean, but during peak hours it can get noisy and a bit messy until the staff clears tables.

Overall, Burger King is a solid choice for fast food lovers who want a heavier, more flavorful burger than what some other chains offer. Just pick your timing right if you want a fresh, hot meal without the wait.
